paragraphs.name: Situation
paragraphs.plain: Where the tag rail stands: the orders that built it, what DARKROOM can do now, and what the tags on disk actually say as of today.

strand.last: Three builds in one night on 9/9, the CAPTCHA sweep and Tier 2 probes on 9/10, ADORNED applied on 9/11.
strand.plan: Chief tags solo through DARKROOM; the probes retrain on what he confirms.
strand.you: You took over the tagging yourself on 9/11 and asked 9/16 how many more tags you need.
strand.next: The 300-image calibration pass, the honest accuracy number the CAPTCHA sweep can't give.

items.t: **"Go. Green light. Go."** — spoken 9/9 after the tagging consult; the order to build the tag rail and Tier 1 zero-shot tagging.
**"I'm gonna go ahead and start working on BOLO 44"** — spoken 9/11; Chief takes the tagging over himself.
**"vocab go"** — spoken 9/11; ADORNED ruled and applied to vocab.json in place of implied.
**"run the darkroom"** — the proword; DARKROOM relaunched 9/11 and again 9/16 (it had been down since the 9/10 session).
**"how many more tags do I need?"** — asked 9/16; answered: not for the rail, for the probes.

DARKROOM 1.1: a per-axis tag rail on the right (dashed = proposal + confidence, solid = ruling, ∅ = none, A accepts every proposal on the image or Shift for a range), every axis as a left-rail filter, `/api/tags` merging per image into `_pipeline/tags.json`.

`vocab.json` v0.1: the Stage-2 axis vocabularies for the six Tier-1 axes (setting, styling, dress state, production register, mood, framing), 6 axes and 48 values, Claude drafts and Chief strikes by correcting.

`zeroshot_pass.py`: the CLIP text encoder run over the existing `embeddings.npy`, writing top label plus confidence per axis per image to `tags_auto.json`; ran over all 58,419 images in 6 seconds on CPU.
The TAGGING module (fifth tab, hotkey T) and the CAPTCHA module (sixth tab, hotkey C) for fast one-image and grid-based confirmation, plus an undo/redo stack over every tag action.
`probe_pass.py` (Tier 2): a bake-off of zero-shot vs Rocchio prototypes vs one-vs-rest logistic regression per axis; OVR-LR won every axis and now feeds DARKROOM's proposals.
DARKROOM relaunched on the proword, serving on :8484 (was down since the 9/10 session).
16,511 images carry at least one ruling. Positive rulings per axis: styling 495 · setting 450 · register 362 · dress 315 · mood 309 · framing 282.

Every value on every axis sits at the CAPTCHA floor (40 to 47 confirmations); thinnest are mood/candid 40, framing/threeq 41, setting/car 40, register/ai 40, dress/implied 42, styling/streetwear 41. Rejections (the ~axis entries) run in the thousands per axis.
Probe accuracy at park (sampling-biased): register 82 · setting 78 · dress 75 · styling 74 · framing 69 · mood 66; zero-shot was 52 to 62.
Still unbuilt from the card's resume order: the Retrain button and the solo-only queue toggle in the Tags panel (item 4); Tier 3 and Stage 4 clustering (item 5).

paragraphs.main_effort: The 300-image calibration pass, then retrain. Everything after keys off the honest number.

phases.t: **"Go. Green light. Go."** ordered 9/9 after the tagging consult; DARKROOM 1.1 built same night: tag rail (right rail, dashed = proposal + confidence, solid = ruling, ∅ = none, A accepts all or Shift a range), axis filters on the left rail, `/api/tags` merge-per-image to `_pipeline/tags.json`. `vocab.json` v0.1 (6 axes, 48 values) and `zeroshot_pass.py` run over all 58,419 embeddings in 6 seconds on CPU, producing `tags_auto.json` and `darkroom_tags.js`.

**Same night, on Chief's orders:** Tags panel boxed off from Curation, draggable rail edges plus a remembered RAIL TEXT slider, and the TAGGING module built (fifth tab, hotkey T) for one-image-at-a-time keyed tagging across all six axes.

**Then:** an undo/redo stack (Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z / Ctrl+Y) over every tag action, Bratty added to Mood, Wardrobe rebuilt (14 values), and the CAPTCHA module built (sixth tab, hotkey C) to generate the Tier 2 probe's negative training signal.

**CAPTCHA sweep done:** every value on every axis reached at least 40 confirmations, 16,496 records carrying negatives. **Tier 2 shipped:** `probe_pass.py` baked off zero-shot vs Rocchio vs one-vs-rest logistic regression; OVR-LR won every axis (register 82 · setting 78 · dress 75 · styling 74 · framing 69 · mood 66, against zero-shot's 52 to 62). DARKROOM's proposals now come from the probes.

Vocabulary revised through the night on Chief's orders (Video out, AI generated in, Club to Public space, Y2K + Uniform + Loungewear out, Going-out to Lewd, Bratty into Mood); a first numpy-GD probe attempt shipped worse proposals for about ten minutes, caught and reverted.
Chief took BOLO 44 over himself ("I'm gonna go ahead and start working on BOLO 44"); DARKROOM relaunched for him on the "run the darkroom" proword, serving on :8484.

Implied retired from the dress axis (spoken ruling); its opposite value benched on BOLO 48 as ADORNED (recommended) among five alternatives. **ADORNED ruled and applied** ("vocab go"): `vocab.json` edited (implied out, adorned in with three prompts), `zeroshot_pass.py` rerun, `probe_pass.py` retrained; Chief's 42 human confirmations carrying implied stay untouched as his record.
**Resume item 1 — run the darkroom.** Relaunched on the proword 9/16, serving on :8484 (had been down since the 9/10 session).

**Resume item 2 — the 300-image calibration pass.** Library CAST to Solo, TAGGING tab (T), first 300 images in catalog order — the honest, unbiased accuracy number the sampling-biased CAPTCHA sweep can't give.
**Resume item 3 — retrain.** Run `probe_pass.py` (about 10 seconds) after the calibration pass and after each further tagging session.
**Resume item 4 — Retrain button + solo-only queue toggle.** Wire a Retrain button into the Tags panel and a toggle to restrict the queue to solo images; waits on the next server restart.
**Resume item 5 — Tier 3.** L2b cells with Chief's eyes, module 2 as the prior, population signatures; Stage 4 clustering also still unbuilt.

paragraphs.name: Command & Signal
paragraphs.plain: Who calls what. You rule images; Claude builds the rail and retrains the probes on your word.

strand.last: Since 9/11 this BOLO has been yours alone; Claude's last touch was the ADORNED rename.
strand.plan: You tag, you say retrain, Claude wires the button so you stop having to say it.
strand.you: Every ruling is yours; no probe output is ever written as a ruling without your key.
strand.next: Say "build the retrain button" or start the calibration pass, either order.

items.t: **ACTUAL** — every tag ruling, the vocabulary, when a session ends. **Claude** — the rail, the modules, `probe_pass.py`, the counts; proposes, never rules.
**None on the machine side.** The probes are live; the only gate is your time at the TAGGING tab. Accuracy rises with rulings, about a hundred per value before it plateaus.
[[run-the-darkroom|run the darkroom]] — relaunch the server · "retrain" — `probe_pass.py`, ten seconds · **T** — the TAGGING tab · **Space** — commit the proposals and advance.
